intro:
Morning walk east: Liwan Lake, Lychee Bay, Xiguan mansions, Bruce Lee's home
Yongqingfang: boutiques and gifts (PICOCICI flagship)
Ice cream at Shun Kee; lunch at Tao Tao Ju
Afternoon: Shangxiajiu arcades to Liwan Plaza
Dinner: Panxi Restaurant

food.name: Baohua Noodle Shop (宝华面店)
food.desc: A morning bowl of bamboo-pole wonton noodles

food.name: Ng Zham Kee (伍湛记)
food.desc: Longjin East Road; jidi congee with salted fried cakes. Opens 08:00.

items.title: Morning: on foot east from the hotel
items.note: All on foot, west to east, no backtracking. Nearly two hours are kept for Yongqingfang so the kids can browse boutiques and buy gifts.

route.title: Liwan Lake Park (荔湾湖公园)
route.desc: Lakeside stroll; see the small Qing-style garden Xiaohuafangzhai (小画舫斋). Elderly locals often sing Cantonese opera here.

route.title: Lychee Bay canal and Wenta Pagoda (荔枝湾涌、文塔)
route.desc: Xiguan houses line both banks; walk to Wenta Pagoda for photos. Lychee Bay is the birthplace of sampan congee (艇仔粥).

route.title: Xiguan mansions on Fengyuan Street (逢源大街西关大屋)
route.desc: Sliding-bar gates (趟栊门) and Manchu stained-glass windows (满洲窗) of old Guangzhou's wealthy households.

route.title: Cantonese Opera Art Museum (粤剧艺术博物馆)
route.walk: ~10 min walk south to Enning Road
route.desc: Lingnan garden-style buildings; a quick visit is enough. Closed Mondays, open Wednesdays.

route.title: Bruce Lee's Ancestral Home (李小龙祖居)
route.walk: Cross Enning Road, ~5 min, on Yongqing 1st Lane in Yongqingfang
route.desc: Go in for a look and photos.

route.title: Yongqingfang boutiques and creative shops (永庆坊精品店、文创小店)
route.walk: Browse slowly through the arcade lanes
route.desc: Qilou (arcade buildings) are a Lingnan street form: ground-floor shops are set back, and the upper floors project over the pavement on a row of columns, so the walkway below is shaded from sun and rain. Yongqingfang is a block of restored qilou and old Xiguan houses, mainly Yongqing 1st Lane, Yongqing 2nd Lane and Fushang Lane: narrow lanes, grey-brick walls, sliding-bar gates, packed with creative-design shops, handmade-craft stalls and intangible-heritage gift shops. Fushang Lane has the PICOCICI global flagship store, selling Sanrio, Disney and Chiikawa merchandise, a sure hit with the kids.
route.tip: PICOCICI details are from summer 2026 reports. Other small shops change quickly; buy when something appeals.

route.title: Coffee
route.tip: Yongqingfang shop details are from a 2022 guide; some shops may have changed. Check on site.

food.name: Gonglu Coffee (公路咖啡)
food.desc: Caffeine-free drinks can be ordered for the kids

food.name: Claypot latte (煲仔拿铁)
food.desc: Latte served in a clay pot; very photogenic

route.title: Jiale Egg Tart King (嘉乐蛋挞王)
route.desc: Egg tarts in 8 flavours; buy several and share.

route.title: Yongqing Food Hall (永庆食集)
route.walk: Inside Yongqingfang; heritage snack brands under one roof
route.desc: Grandma's beef offal (阿婆牛杂), Bazhen pan-fried dumplings (八珍煎饺) and Hong Kong Yuanyang King (香港鸳鸯王) are all here. Try only one or two before lunch; one yuanyang milk tea can be shared.

route.title: Enning Ice Cream (恩宁雪糕行)
route.desc: Local-flavour ice cream: chicken biscuit (鸡仔饼), ginger milk curd, Phoenix Dancong tea (凤凰单枞), milk tea. Next door, Enning Gongfei (恩宁公啡) is known for its “檬茶茶”: hand-pulled black tea with dried plum and lemon.

route.title: Enning Road arcade street (恩宁路骑楼街)
route.walk: ~10 min walk east along Enning Road
route.desc: Old arcade streetscape all the way; photos on the move. At the east end, Shun Kee is just off Baohua Road; Tao Tao Ju on Dishifu Road is a few minutes further.

route.title: Shun Kee Ice Bar (顺记冰室)
route.walk: At the east end of Enning Road, turn into Baohua Road; ~3 min walk to No. 85.
route.desc: Classic ice bar; coconut and mango ice cream are the signatures. Enning ice cream was just had, so one cup is shared.

items.title: Lunch: Tao Tao Ju (陶陶居), Dishifu Road
items.note: The flagship, open since 1880; Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street is right outside. ~3 min walk from Shun Kee. After 13:00 on a Wednesday the lunch peak is easing and queues are much shorter. Take a queue number on arrival.

food.name: Char siu buns, chicken feet (叉烧包、凤爪)
Malay sponge cake, red rice roll (马拉糕、红米肠)

items.tip: Old teahouses usually charge a per-person tea fee; expect it before sitting down.

items.title: Tao Tao Ju → Liwan Plaza
items.note: Walk east along Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street, arcades the whole way.

route.title: Lingnan Art Studio former residence (岭南艺苑故屋)
route.walk: From Tao Tao Ju, turn into Zhanlu Zhijie; ~3 min walk
route.desc: Former home and studio where Lingnan School painting masters ran their academy; a look from the door is enough.

route.title: Xiajiu Road arcades and Wenlan Lane (下九路骑楼、文澜巷)
route.walk: Back on the pedestrian street, heading east
route.desc: Shangxiajiu is Guangzhou's most complete arcade street. Wenlan Lane is where Qing-era Thirteen Hongs merchants founded the Wenlan Academy (文澜书院).

route.title: Hualin Temple and Hualin Jade Street (华林禅寺、华林玉器街)
route.walk: Turn north off Xiajiu Road, ~3 min
route.desc: The old temple and the jade street are side by side; take a look, then return to the pedestrian street.
route.tip: Hualin Temple's opening hours could not be confirmed. Go in if open; otherwise look from the gate.

route.title: Liwan Plaza (荔湾广场)
route.walk: Back on the pedestrian street to the east end of Shangjiu Road

items.title: Liwan Plaza (荔湾广场)
items.note: Long-established mall with many jewellery, watch and small-goods shops; an hour and a half is allowed for browsing.

items.title: Liwan Plaza → Hotel
items.note: Taxi from the entrance, ~10–15 min; slower in evening traffic. Back at the hotel around 16:45.

items.title: Laundry and rest at the hotel
Hotel → Panxi Restaurant (泮溪酒家)
items.note: Panxi Restaurant is at 151 Longjin West Road, beside Liwan Lake Park. ~10 min walk from the hotel towards Liwan Lake; use Amap walking navigation to “泮溪酒家”. Otherwise a minimum-fare taxi, ~5 min.
items.tip: Walking time assumes the Atour is near Lychee Bay; recheck once the hotel address is confirmed.

items.title: Dinner: Panxi Restaurant (泮溪酒家)
items.note: Last night in the old city; a proper meal at the garden restaurant.

food.name: White rabbit dumplings (绿茵白兔饺)
food.desc: Dim sum shaped like little white rabbits; the most photogenic, and a kids' favourite

food.name: Panxi water chestnut cake (泮塘马蹄糕)
food.desc: Made with local Pantang water chestnuts; smooth and lightly sweet

food.name: Honeycomb egg-yolk puffs, quail puff pastry (蜂巢蛋黄角、鹌鹑千层酥)
food.desc: Fried pastries from the restaurant's eight famous dim sum

food.name: Roast suckling pig, eight-treasure winter melon soup (金牌烧乳猪、八宝冬瓜盅)
food.desc: Signatures from the eight famous dishes; for a larger group

items.tip: Booking ahead is recommended; window seats in the garden must be booked early.
